title: CsvLimitsResponse
description: Response body for GET /api/data-sources/csv-limits (HEL-1221) -- the backend's CSV upload caps, the single source of truth clients derive their pre-checks from. `maxBytes` is the file size cap (the multipart entity limit is this plus a fixed overhead margin the client does not need to know); `maxRows` counts data rows excluding the header; `maxCells` is rows x columns. A CSV breaching any of the three is rejected with 413.
